definitions.gloss: cold air, cold weather, cold snap
definitions.explanation: Cold atmospheric conditions or a mass of cold air. Used in weather reports and everyday descriptions of cold weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{寒気|かんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れ{込|こ}む→流れ込む：05748_nagarekomu⟧。
examples.english: A strong cold snap is moving in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寒気|かんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{冷|ひ}え{込|こ}む→冷え込む：11727_hiekomu⟧でしょう。
examples.english: This week will be quite cold due to a cold air mass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大陸|たいりく}→大陸：03400_tairiku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寒気|かんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{日本海側|にほんかいがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらした→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧。
examples.english: Cold air from the continent brought heavy snow to the Sea of Japan side.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily a weather and meteorology term. Often appears in news and weather forecasts. Not to be confused with {寒気|さむけ} (read as さむけ), which means chills or shivers from illness or fear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒気|かんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れ{込|こ}む→流れ込む：05748_nagarekomu⟧: cold air flows in
- {寒気|かんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: influence of cold air
- {寒気|かんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緩|ゆる}む→緩む：10056_yurumu⟧: the cold eases
- ⟦{上空|じょうくう}→上空：03080_joukuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寒気|かんき}: cold air aloft
